datasets.name: PHM 2016 CMP Data Challenge
datasets.note: Sensors and outcome on the same wafers. Used by predict_removal_rate.

datasets.name: WM-811K (LSWMD)
datasets.note: Real maps, real labels. Used standalone by classify_wafer_map — the classifier itself involves no constructed pairing.

datasets.name: SECOM (UCI id=179)
datasets.note: Real readings, anonymised channels, no fault labels — so it can validate detection but not root-cause attribution.

datasets.name: YieldGuard demo lots
datasets.note: SECOM rows paired with WM-811K maps BY US. Each component is real; the join is not. Retained because CMP has no wafer maps and so cannot carry the vision or root-cause demo.

data_provenance.rule: Entities carry a data_provenance block. 'measured' means the sensor-to-outcome link exists in the source data. 'constructed' means we joined unrelated real datasets and no causal claim survives the join.

results.top_hypothesis: Slurry flow rate drift caused by degrading slurry pump on CMP-03

results.top_hypothesis: Incoming slurry vendor lot with out-of-spec viscosity causing center defect pattern

results.top_hypothesis: RF power edge effect following chamber PM reassembly leading to edge-ring defect pattern

results.top_hypothesis: Edge gas flow distribution imbalance from a partially clogged edge gas nozzle

results.top_hypothesis: Chamber wall seasoning drift following a shared-tool recipe change
